svg.aria-label: pytest-triage pipeline: a new issue is read from GitHub and passed through a guard that redacts secrets and paths and fences and datamarks the text as untrusted. One Gemini call assesses labels and missing information using the five most similar labelled issues as examples. Two Gemini calls find duplicates: expand into three root-cause queries, search the issue's own top 8 plus the queries' top 8 with BM25 and embeddings fused by RRF, then verify. A policy check routes flagged issues to a human; otherwise the report shows suggested labels, items for maintainer review, and a reply draft only for outputs at 70% precision or better. About $0.0015 and 3.3 seconds per issue, run daily in read-only shadow mode.
